ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) with high-intensity (white/beige) localized clusters at the distal tips and scattered circular scars; estimated ratio of 96:4 low-to-high intensity pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity dark field across both lobes. Discrete high-contrast white circular rings (scars) located in the medial-right and mid-left lobe regions. High-density, multi-chromatic (white/beige) texture clusters located at the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern observed along the entirety of the trailing edge; right lobe exhibits jagged, irregular peaks of 5-12 pixel amplitude, while the left lobe shows more uniform, lower-amplitude variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the upper boundary of both lobes, originating from the water line and sweeping upward towards the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast ring clusters (rosette pattern) detected: three prominent rings on the right lobe (upper-medial) and two faint rings on the inner-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense acorn barnacle (Coronula diadema) colonization on the distal tips of both lobes, appearing as high-intensity, calcified protrusions. Multiple white ring-shaped attachment scars present across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme barnacle density at the distal tips creating a jagged, non-biological texture boundary distinct from the primary fluke edge topography.
